label: About
title: About Illegal Green Dial Procession
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 75 recent saved-signal files and 71 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @ifeelsomoldy: BAD HAND 2 MORNING,,, LOADING,,,,, 🔜 and Evil Biscuit on Drifella, Trad…–Verse Talks – Apple Podcasts, plus 7 more. A source image from apple.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Illegal Green Dial Procession: Material macro in a product-photo rupture: wide black hero field, side-lit object slab centered in the middle third, warm titanium bevel crossing the plate and one acid-green rubber block descending into darkness. A glossy black aperture holds dense radial micro-glyphs as source grains; a small off-white card plane... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against black glass dial aperture, off-white rounded card field, and central black inscription mass.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
